Method of Attack: Remote code execution via out-of-bounds read vulnerability allowing execution of shell commands as root
Exploitation scenarios include client-side attack via malicious remote SMTP server and server-side attack via bounce email triggering
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation via default OpenSMTPD configuration accepting messages from local users and delivering to remote servers
Man-in-the-middle, DNS, or BGP attacks on SMTP connections (not TLS-encrypted by default)
Sending emails that create bounces triggering vulnerable client-side code
Indicators of Compromise: Commit references: out-of-bounds read introduced in commit 80c6a60c (Dec 2015), code execution possible after commit a8e22235 (May 2018)
